_comment: Automation Website settings - edit this file in the repo (or from the dashboard) to change limits. 0 = UNLIMITED (no cap). paused=true stops all automation. force_topic = write about this topic next. dry_run=true = test mode, nothing is posted. post_window_start/end = only post between these Dhaka times (HH:MM, empty = no window). blogger_enabled / bsky_enabled / replies_enabled / cards_enabled = switch each workflow on/off (true/false). topic_blacklist = comma-separated topics to never write about. Keys and passwords stay in GitHub Secrets, never here.
